english.title: Supply recording equipment without appropriate type-approval certificate
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97ZB(1) and (3) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
supplied recording equipment
as recording equipment which complied with the EU Tachographs Regulation / the AETR
in respect of which no appropriate type-approval certificate was in force

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 97B(2) of the Transport Act 1968 provides a defence exists where the recording equipment was supplied for export from Great Britain, the person had reasonable cause to believe that the recording equipment would not be installed until an appropriate type-approval certificate was in force; or the person had reasonable cause to believe that the recording equipment would only be installed in a vehicle which was not required under the relevant instrument to have recording equipment installed in it.
(ii) Section 97B(8) states that nothing in the offence affects the validity of a contract or any rights arising under or in relation to a contract.
